column3: “Prince of the head of Meshech” is rendered “the prince of Rosh, Meshech,” taking “head” as a name.
“Prince of the head” is rendered “prince of Rosh.”
“Guard” follows the Hebrew; the LXX reads “for me.”
“Mustered” is rendered “summoned,” and “end of the years” as “latter years.”
“Words on your heart” is rendered “thoughts … into your mind.”
NASB supplies “now” and renders “navel of the earth” as “center of the world.”
“Young lions” is rendered “villages,” following a slightly different reading.
NASB adds the question form (“Are you the one”).
“Rage in my nose” is rendered “fury will mount up in My anger.”
“To all my mountains” is rendered “on all My mountains”; the LXX reads “every terror.”
NASB moves the phrases; “rain overflowing” is rendered “torrential rain.”
